title: Amazing Whipped Potatoes
description: These whipped potatoes with butter, cream cheese, and sour cream are deliciously rich and fluffy — the perfect potato side dish to complete any meal.
ingredients: 5 pounds yellow potatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch cubs
0.25 cup cream cheese at room temperature
0.5 cup warm milk, or more as needed
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes; drain and transfer to a large bowl.
Add butter and cream cheese to potatoes; beat with an electric mixer until butter is nearly melted. Add milk and sour cream; continue to beat until smooth. Season with salt and black pepper.
